## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Meshes
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - ISurface meshes
//  - Mesh attributes
//  - Unwelded face arrays
//  - Line sets and bare point clouds
//  - Mesh partitioning
//  - Volumetric meshes

//==
// # ISurface meshes
//
// Indexed surface geometry: shared vertex position arrays referenced by typed
// face records. All faces wind counter-clockwise when viewed from the front
// (outside), matching WindingOrder.CounterClockwise. IFace records index into the
// owning mesh's Positions array; every index must be valid (no -1 inside faces).
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals (the outward
// face normal follows the right-hand rule over the CCW vertex order).

//==
// ## IFace records

// The three vertex indices of one triangle, wound counter-clockwise when
// viewed from the front side. IFace supplies IValue, IHashable, and the
// IIndexable<VertexIndex> corner surface (Count/At bodies in
// `meshes.library.plato`).
type TriangleFace
    implements IFace
{
    A: VertexIndex;
    B: VertexIndex;
    C: VertexIndex;
}

// The four vertex indices of one quadrilateral face, wound counter-clockwise
// when viewed from the front side. Coplanarity is not guaranteed; when a
// planar approximation is needed, split along the A-C diagonal — FanTriangles
// in `meshes.library.plato` is that split.
type QuadFace
    implements IFace
{
    A: VertexIndex;
    B: VertexIndex;
    C: VertexIndex;
    D: VertexIndex;
}

//==
// ## ISurface meshes

// An indexed triangle mesh in 3D
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triangle_mesh): the workhorse interchange
// representation for surface geometry. Faces index into Positions.
type TriangleMesh3D
    implements IValue, ITriangulatedGeometry3D, IIndexedTriangleGeometry3D, IMeshElementCounts, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    Faces: Array<TriangleFace>;
}

// An indexed triangle mesh in the plane: triangulations of polygons, Delaunay
// triangulations, finite-element meshes. Faces wind counter-clockwise.
type TriangleMesh2D
    implements IValue, IMesh2D, IIndexedTriangleGeometry2D, IMeshElementCounts, IDeformable2D
{
    Positions: Array<Point2D>;
    Faces: Array<TriangleFace>;
}

// An indexed quadrilateral mesh in 3D: subdivision cages, quad-dominant
// retopology, structured patches.
type QuadMesh3D
    implements IValue, IMesh3D, IIndexedQuadGeometry3D, IMeshElementCounts, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    Faces: Array<QuadFace>;
}

// A mesh of arbitrary-arity faces (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygon_mesh):
// Faces is a table with one row per face, holding that face's corner loop wound
// counter-clockwise. Mixed face sizes are representable (Archimedean); uniform
// n-gons (Platonic/Catalan) use the same type — no separate fixed-arity
// polygon-mesh storage. TriangleMesh3D / QuadMesh3D remain the specialized
// interchange forms. Initial Conway catalog: C# `Ara3D.Geometry.Polyhedra` /
// `PolygonMesh3D` / `ConwayOperators`.
//
// The mesh HAS a jagged face table rather than IS one: `JaggedArray<VertexIndex>`
// (`collections-jagged.types.plato`) already implements `IJagged<T>` and carries the CSR
// packing invariant, so every row query is reused through `m.Faces` — without the
// generic names `Offsets` / `Values` landing on the mesh itself. Further jagged
// members (vertex-to-face adjacency, for one) are then additional fields rather
// than a second interface the type cannot implement twice.
type PolygonMesh3D
    implements IValue, IMesh3D, IMeshElementCounts, IMeshIncidence, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    Faces: JaggedArray<VertexIndex>;
}

//==
// # Mesh attributes
//
// Named data channels layered over a base mesh: normals, UVs, colors,
// weights, tangents. A channel's storage length is dictated by its domain
// (per-vertex, per-face, per-corner, per-undirected-edge, or uniform). Channels
// are parallel arrays; they never alter the base mesh's connectivity.

// Which mesh element an attribute's values attach to: one value per vertex,
// per face, per face-vertex slot (allowing seams and hard edges), per
// undirected edge, or a single value for the whole mesh.
type AttributeDomain = PerVertex | PerFace | PerCorner | PerUndirectedEdge | Uniform;

// A named channel of per-element values. The length of Values must equal
// the element count implied by Domain (exactly 1 when Uniform). Names are
// unique within one channel group of a mesh.
type MeshAttribute<T>
{
    Name: String;
    Domain: AttributeDomain;
    Values: Array<T>;
}

// An orthonormal surface frame for normal mapping
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normal_mapping) and anisotropic shading.
// Handedness is +1 or -1: the sign relating Bitangent to the cross product of
// Normal and Tangent (mirrored UV islands flip it).
type TangentBasis
    implements IValue
{
    Tangent: Direction3D;
    Bitangent: Direction3D;
    Normal: Direction3D;
    Handedness: Number;
}

// A triangle mesh plus typed attribute channels, grouped by value type.
// An absent group is an empty array. Well-known channel names include
// "normal" (PerVertex or PerCorner Vector3D), "uv0" (PerCorner UvCoordinate),
// and "color" (PerVertex Color).
type RichMesh3D
    implements IValue, IMesh3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Mesh: TriangleMesh3D;
    NumberChannels: Array<MeshAttribute<Number>>;
    IntegerChannels: Array<MeshAttribute<Integer>>;
    VectorChannels: Array<MeshAttribute<Vector3D>>;
    UvChannels: Array<MeshAttribute<UvCoordinate>>;
    ColorChannels: Array<MeshAttribute<Color>>;
    TangentChannels: Array<MeshAttribute<TangentBasis>>;
}
```
